reference: Hou R, Tang S, Jin W. An Adaptive Machine Learning Triage Framework for Predicting Alzheimer's Disease Progression. ML4H Findings Track. 2025. arXiv:2511.06681.
role: Closest dementia triage comparator; confidence-gain targets motivate our matched target comparison. Different datasets, tasks and gate architecture prevent direct performance comparison.

reference: Ma C, Tschiatschek S, Palla K, Hernandez-Lobato JM, Nowozin S, Zhang C. EDDI Efficient Dynamic Discovery of High-Value Information with Partial VAE. ICML. PMLR 97:4234–4243. 2019.
role: Prior information-gain acquisition. Our Gaussian comparator is explicitly simplified and does not reproduce EDDI.

reference: Li Y, Oliva J. Active Feature Acquisition with Generative Surrogate Models. ICML. PMLR 139:6450–6459. 2021.
role: Motivates modeling unobserved features conditional on observed inputs; our comparator has no reinforcement-learning agent.

reference: Valancius M, Lennon M, Oliva J. Acquisition Conditioned Oracle for Nongreedy Active Feature Acquisition. ICML. PMLR 235:48957–48975. 2024.
role: Established nongreedy acquisition literature; our one-panel batch allocation does not address sequential feature complementarities. Our outcome-informed diagnostic oracle is not the ACO algorithm.

reference: Guney OB, Saichandran KS, Elzokm K, Zhang Z, Kolachalama VB. Active feature acquisition via explainability-driven ranking. ICML. PMLR 267:20748–20765. 2025.
role: Prior individual acquisition rankings learned from explanations. Our gate is learned from observed loss changes, not a transformer or SHAP ranking.

reference: Kobayashi Y, Jing Z, Yao J, Namkoong H, Joshi S. Learning-To-Measure In-Context Active Feature Acquisition. ICML. PMLR 306:59720–59752. 2026.
role: Recent uncertainty-guided conditional-information acquisition; limits novelty claims. Our small task-specific models do not reproduce its pretrained in-context method.

reference: Wyss P, Ginsbourger D, Shou H, Davatzikos C, Kloppel S, Abdulkadir A. Adaptive data-driven selection of sequences of biological and cognitive markers in pre-clinical diagnosis of dementia. Scientific Reports. 2023;13:6406.
role: POSEIDON establishes prior adaptive dementia marker sequencing and costs; our question concerns equal-capacity referral uncertainty.

reference: Marcus DS, Wang TH, Parker J, Csernansky JG, Morris JC, Buckner RL. Open Access Series of Imaging Studies Cross-sectional MRI Data in Young, Middle Aged, Nondemented, and Demented Older Adults. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2007;19:1498–1507.
role: Original OASIS 1 data source; CDR endpoint must not be relabeled as confirmed Alzheimer pathology.

reference: Marcus DS, Fotenos AF, Csernansky JG, Morris JC, Buckner RL. Open Access Series of Imaging Studies Longitudinal MRI Data in Nondemented and Demented Older Adults. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2010;22:2677–2684.
role: Original OASIS 2 data source; earliest visit is used, not a progression endpoint.

reference: Dakterzada F, et al. Changes in Plasma Neutral and Ether-Linked Lipids Are Associated with The Pathology and Progression of Alzheimer's Disease. Aging and Disease. 2023;14:1728–1738.
role: Source clinical cohort for measured CSF values; our clinical table contains 212 observations whereas the publication describes 213.

reference: Sol J, et al. Plasma lipidomics in Alzheimer's disease and its progression. CORA Research Data Repository. 2023. doi:10.34810/DATA614.
role: Original repository and reuse terms. Local bytes are verified against the public clinical-table mirror, not directly against original repository bytes.

reference: Miltiadous A, et al. A Dataset of Scalp EEG Recordings of Alzheimer's Disease, Frontotemporal Dementia and Healthy Subjects from Routine EEG. Data. 2023;8:95.
role: New real EEG source, OpenNeuro ds004504 v1.0.9. One measured feature row per AD/FTD participant; provider-denoised recordings and patient-level partitions.

reference: Miltiadous A, Gionanidis E, Tzimourta KD, Giannakeas N, Tzallas AT. DICE-net A Novel Convolution-Transformer Architecture for Alzheimer Detection in EEG Signals. IEEE Access. 2023. doi:10.1109/ACCESS.2023.3294618.

reference: Miltiadous A, et al. The AHEPA EEG benchmark setting the standard for machine learning in dementia diagnosis, a scoping review. Cognitive Neurodynamics. 2026;20:95.
role: Dataset-specific methodological review requested by provider. Supports explicit patient-level validation; no epoch-level partition or comparison of incompatible validation designs.

reference: Angelopoulos AN, Bates S, Fisch A, Lei L, Schuster T. Conformal Risk Control. ICLR. 2024.
role: Distinguishes formal risk control from our conditional posterior penalty. We do not implement conformal risk control or claim its guarantees.

reference: Collins GS, et al. TRIPOD+AI statement updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods. BMJ. 2024;385:e078378.
role: Reporting framework, not a clinical validity certification.
